_meta.description: Events worth going to during a trip. Rendered by places/build_events.py into places/events-data.js for the Walkabout Events tab (month calendar + list). Found and refreshed by the events routine in places/EVENTS.md.
_meta.scoring: score = number of distinct goal ids in goals[] (0-6). Each type below is one goal; an event's type is the goal it serves best, goals[] lists every goal it genuinely serves.

schema.title: event name
schema.goals: list of ids from types[]; every goal the event genuinely serves, including its type. Drives the score.
schema.date: YYYY-MM-DD, one-off events (first day if multi-day). Exactly one of date / recurring.
schema.end_date: YYYY-MM-DD, multi-day events and exhibitions only
schema.recurring: {freq:'weekly', weekdays:['tue']} | {freq:'monthly', nth:1..4 or -1 (last), weekday:'fri'} | {freq:'daily'}; optional from / until (YYYY-MM-DD, default: trip dates) and except: [dates]
schema.time: HH:MM start, Bangkok time, or null
schema.place_id: optional id from data/places.json when the venue is a saved place (adds 'Show on map')
schema.price: as listed, e.g. 'Free', '300 THB incl. 1 drink'
schema.url: event or group page the facts came from
schema.notes: what it is, why go, caveats (RSVP, sells out)
schema.confidence: confirmed = a listing for this exact date was seen (page or search result) | likely = recurring or annual pattern with recent evidence
schema.verified: YYYY-MM-DD last checked against the source

events.title: Sterling 24 PickleBall'in Bangkok - open play
events.address: 109 Sukhumvit 24 Alley, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok
events.notes: Reclub club with 4,852 members and 869 activities; upcoming weekly open play at Sterling Sport & Wellness includes Thu 14:00 Afternoon Open Play (400 THB), Fri 15:00 Open Play (400 THB), Fri 20:00 Open Play Social, Sun 12:00 Advanced Open Play 3.0+, Sun 20:00 Open Play+ (450 THB) and Mon 10:00 Open Play, each 2 hours. Sessions also include drills and DUPR mini tournaments; join the specific meet in Reclub, as some fill up and waitlist.

events.title: Wat Mahathat - daily English vipassana meditation classes (Section 5)

events.address: 3 Maha Rat Rd, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok
events.notes: Drop-in guided vipassana with English-speaking monks at the International Buddhist Meditation Centre near the Grand Palace, donation-based; third-party listings show three sessions a day through late 2026. Exact session times were not seen - confirm on site; wear modest (ideally white) clothing.

events.title: Bangkok Runners - Tuesday morning social run
events.venue: Benjakitti Park (north end, on the running track near the car park)
events.notes: Meetup lists 'The 2026 Easy Peasy Benjakitti / Lumpini Park Run' every Tuesday 06:30-07:15 (dated events for 24 Nov through 12 Jan and beyond), about 5-7 km at 6.5-8 min/km, starting 06:35 from the north end of Benjakitti Park near the car park (GPS 13.732738, 100.559109). May be postponed for rain; walk-only at PM2.5 100-120 and cancelled above 120 - check the Meetup chat.

events.title: Sabai Run Club - weekend community run
events.notes: Relaxed free community run; the June-2026 guide lists Sunday 07:15 near Queen Sirikit Convention Center/Benjakitti, while Time Out describes Saturday runs rotating between parks - so the day is not settled. The club also posts one-off events on Luma (luma.com/h3jy37nm); check its Instagram before going.

events.title: Royal International Pickleball Club - Saturday open play
events.address: 2784 Sukhumvit 66 Alley, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok
events.notes: Reclub lists 'Open Play: Saturday Morning Pickleball at Beat Discovery' every Saturday at 09:00 (dated meets for 14, 21 and 28 Nov), 250 THB per player, levels 2.5-4.0, three rented courts. The meet pages show a 3-hour duration while the club blurb says 09:00-11:00; you stay waitlisted until you pay and send the receipt.

events.title: AI Engineers Meetup Bangkok (weekly Saturday coffee/hands-on session)

events.address: Siam Paragon, 991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok
events.notes: Weekly coffee meetup for coders of all levels to discuss and try the week's new AI tech; bring a charged laptop if you want to demo. Meetup lists dated Saturday sessions 10:00-13:00 on 21 and 28 Nov and 5, 12, 19 and 26 Dec 2026; nothing is listed after 26 Dec yet. RSVP on Meetup.

events.title: Not Your Business club: Weekly Co-working Sessions (Bangkok Digital Nomads)
events.venue: Rotates weekly (9 Nov: Ryoku Cafe, Sukhumvit 35; 2 Nov: hands and heart coffee roasters, Sukhumvit 67)
events.organizer: Bangkok Digital Nomads Community x Not Your Office
events.notes: Monday co-working day (arrive from 10:00, focus hours 14:00-16:00, wrap-up to 17:00); attendees are asked to order at least one item at the host cafe. Each session is posted individually on Meetup with a different cafe; the latest was #8 on Mon 9 Nov 2026 and no in-window date was listed yet as of 12 Nov.

events.title: SP Pickleball Club - weekly open play
events.address: 224 Sukhumvit 103 Rd, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok
events.notes: Reclub lists 3-hour 'Weekly Open Play' meets at SP Pickleball Club: Mon (Beginner and DUPR 3.0+ sessions), Tue, Thu and Fri (Beginner) at 13:00 and Sat at 12:00, 190 THB per player paid at the counter (cash/QR). Join each meet in Reclub; a no-show or cancelling under 6 hours before is charged in full. No Wednesday session appeared among the six upcoming meets shown.

events.title: Lingping Club - Thai Discussions (level-based groups)
events.venue: Asoke-Thong Lo (Sat) / White Cloud Ari (Sun); exact locations on lingpingclub.com
events.price: 300 THB per day / 1000 THB per month (first time free)
events.notes: Small level-based Thai discussion groups (max 6 per group, all levels) listed as 'Thai Intermediate+': Saturdays 14:00-15:00 at Asoke-Thong Lo and Sundays 14:00-15:00 at White Cloud Ari, with dated sessions on 21 and 22 Nov 2026; the Thursday slots are now Chinese/English at LOFTER Central Chidlom. Advance booking is required on lingpingclub.com (not Meetup), where exact locations are shown; 300 THB/day or 1000 THB/month, first time free. Later in-window dates were not yet listed.

events.title: Sunday Language Exchange (Thai-English)
events.address: 100 N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500
events.organizer: Bangkok Cultural Exchange Meetup (Roy, Fai Puntida)
events.notes: Every Sunday 14:00-16:00 at McDonald's Sathorn Nakhon Tower (BTS Chong Nonsi, Exit 2), all levels welcome; Meetup lists sessions for 22 and 29 Nov 2026 (RSVP cap 30). Event fee is 40 THB and attendees are asked to buy a food or drink item.

events.title: Read Thai for Beginners to Intermediate (Gateway Ekkamai)
events.address: Sukhumvit Road 42, Ekkamai, Bangkok
events.notes: Thai reading session every Saturday 16:30-18:30 at the Food Lounge on the 4th floor of Gateway Ekkamai (BTS Ekkamai Exit 4, big table near the cashier); Meetup series runs until 19 Dec 2026 with active dates 21 and 28 Nov and 5, 12, 19 Dec. Fee 150 THB payable at the event, RSVP capped at 10, bring a notebook and pen; the 31 Oct session was cancelled, so check the listing.

events.title: Walk & Learn Thai (Benchakitti Park)
events.notes: Weekly Sunday 17:00-19:00 at Benchakitti Park: an easy 2-3 km walk with new vocab/phrases plus a game-based Thai lesson; Thai speakers are invited to help teach. Meetup lists every Sunday from 22 Nov 2026 to beyond the window; no fee is stated on the page, and single sessions do get cancelled (e.g. 27 Sep), so check the listing.

events.title: LIAN THAI: Thai Language & Culture Exchange with Wini & Friends
events.venue: BKK Diner - American & Thai Comfort Food (2nd floor, Sukhumvit 15)
events.address: 219/3 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110
events.price: 200 THB with a drink purchase / 400 THB without (includes 1 soft drink)
events.notes: Thai-English language and culture exchange in small level-matched groups every Wednesday 17:45-20:00; Meetup series runs until 23 Dec 2026 (in-window dates 25 Nov, 2, 9, 16, 23 Dec) at BKK Diner near BTS Asok / MRT Sukhumvit. Reserve with Wini via the LINE/WhatsApp contacts on the page and message ahead if a complete beginner; the venue has moved before (Mezze Farm to Table until 11 Nov) and the 21 Oct session was cancelled.

events.title: Lumpini Running Club - evening social runs
events.notes: Meetup lists 'Evening Run in Lumpini Park' every Tuesday and Thursday (dated events from 19 Nov through January): meet about 17:45 inside Gate 4 by the water shop (BTS Sala Daeng / MRT Silom exit 1), run starts around 18:00 after the national anthem, usually 2-3 laps at your own pace. All levels and visitors welcome; cancelled if it rains, and the 22 Oct run was cancelled.

events.title: Weekly Meet & Play Night (social games & icebreakers)
events.address: 19/1 Ekkamai 12 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110
events.notes: Weekly icebreaker and light board-games meetup, mainly in English, every Wednesday 18:00-21:00 at Coucou Social Game Bar (Ekkamai Soi 12); Meetup series runs until 27 Jan 2027 with dated instances each week of the window (RSVP cap 45). Free to join, but the venue charges 80 THB per person for unlimited games and snacks and the hosts ask you to buy a drink or food.

events.title: Bangkok Football Meetup - drop-in games (Fun Cup and 6-a-side)
events.venue: Soccer Pro On Nut 17 (Mon/Fri) / Cruzeiro EC Brazilian Soccer Academy (Wed)
events.address: 312 On Nut 17 Alley, Suan Luang (Mon/Fri); 17/1 Pridi Banomyong 21 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana (Wed)
events.price: 200 THB cash for the Wednesday 6-a-side; Fun Cup fee not shown
events.notes: Meetup shows a steady weekly pattern: 'Fun Cup' social tournaments Monday and Friday 18:15-20:00 at Soccer Pro On Nut 17 (around 22-24 going) and a 6-a-side game Wednesday 18:30-20:00 at Cruzeiro EC on Pridi Banomyong 21 (200 THB cash). Events are posted about a week ahead, so the latest dated ones were 13, 16 and 18 Nov; RSVP on Meetup and pay by bank transfer or cash.

events.title: Bangkok Digital Nomads Weekly Meetup (Thursday social)
events.venue: Rotates weekly: Amber Bar, Wyndham Bangkok Queen Convention Centre (19 Nov); The Gardens of Dinsor Palace, Ekkamai (26 Nov); December locations to be announced
events.notes: Weekly nomad/expat/local social every Thursday 18:30-23:00 at a different venue each week; Meetup lists dated events through 31 Dec 2026: 19 Nov at Amber Bar (316 Asok Montri Rd, lift to 33F then stairs to the rooftop), 26 Nov at The Gardens of Dinsor Palace, and 3-31 Dec titled 'Location To Be Announced'. Free to attend; guests are asked to order at least one drink or food item.

events.title: Little Bangkok Sangha - Monday meditation & Dhamma talk (English)
events.address: 1 Soi Ari 1, Phaya Thai, Bangkok (near BTS Ari)
events.notes: English-language Buddhist group at Baan Aree: 18:30 group meditation, 19:00 Dhamma talk, 20:00 finish; no charge, dana boxes provided, dress modestly. Meetup lists Monday sessions on 23 and 30 Nov, 7 and 14 Dec 2026 and 4 and 11 Jan 2027 (first Monday 'Original Dharma', second Monday 'Life Universe and Dhamma', guest teachers on other Mondays) plus an extra Tuesday talk on 24 Nov; 21 and 28 Dec are not listed yet.

events.title: AI & Beers (every 2-3 weeks: check the date)
events.notes: Presentation-free evening of AI builders and users over beers. Not strictly weekly: recent editions were Thursdays 24 Sep, 15 Oct, 29 Oct and 12 Nov 2026 (#11), i.e. every 2-3 weeks; #12 was not yet listed, so check the group's WhatsApp/listing for the next date.

events.title: Bangkok Social and Language Exchange (Make New Friends)

events.price: 100 THB (online only, no tickets at door)

Caveat: the individual date pages for 20 Nov-25 Dec exist only as unpublished drafts, so buy a ticket for the specific date before going.

events.title: Board Games Night at the FCCT (The Boring Club)

The FCCT site lists dated nights individually, most recently Tue 17 Nov 2026; no in-window date was posted yet as of 12 Nov.

events.notes: Free Tuesday social with board and card games at Coucou Social Game Bar & Cafe; Meetup lists Tue 24 Nov 2026 as 19:00-21:00, although the description says it starts at 7:30 PM and the 10 and 17 Nov sessions were listed 19:30-23:30. The only cost is 80 THB per person paid to the bar for unlimited games (free snacks; buying a drink is appreciated); sessions are posted individually, so later dates were not yet listed.

events.title: Weekly Nomad Board Games Night by Nomads for Impact

Meetup series runs until 25 Dec 2026 with dated instances every Friday from 20 Nov; 100 THB minimum spend to support the venue.

events.title: Pub Quiz at The Deck (BKK Quiz Masters)

events.notes: Thursday pub quiz hosted by BKK Quiz Masters at The Deck Bangkok: free, 7.45pm, with B1,000 in Deck Dollars for the winners, B500 for runners-up and a B500 weekly cash jackpot. Caveat: the Time Out listing is dated 6 Nov 2024 and gives no specific dates, so confirm with the venue that the quiz is still running.

events.title: Polyglots in Bangkok - Monthly Meeting

events.notes: Monthly gathering of language lovers on the 2nd Thursday of every month, 20:00-23:00 at Bourbon Street Restaurant and Oyster Bar. The only in-window date is Thu 10 Dec 2026; the next one is Thu 14 Jan 2027, two days after the window.

events.title: Bangkok Art Biennale 2026 - 'Angels & Mara'
events.venue: 11 main venues across Bangkok (incl. Wat Arun, Wat Pho, BACC, One Bangkok and malls around Siam)
events.price: Free biennale admission (individual venue admission rules and hours apply)
events.notes: Fifth edition of the citywide biennale: more than 200 works by 72 artists and collectives across 11 main venues, with BAB Plus and BAB Fringe extending to Thonburi, Samut Prakan and Suphan Buri. Runs 29 Oct 2026 - 28 Feb 2027 (dates here clipped to the trip window); BACC's 9th-floor display finishes 25 Nov while its 7th- and 8th-floor displays continue to 28 Feb.

events.title: Exhibition: A Neighbour's Memories of BACC - Nakrob Moonmanas
events.address: 939 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok
events.notes: BACC show by collage artist Nakrob Moonmanas, listed 14 Oct - 31 Dec 2026 (start clipped to window). Easy to combine with the Biennale floors in the same building; BACC is closed Mondays.

events.title: Exhibition: CONTINUUM (MOCA collection + 14 contemporary artists)
events.venue: Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok ART Space by MOCA BANGKOK
events.notes: Works by 7 Thai modern artists from the MOCA BANGKOK collection shown alongside new interpretations by 14 contemporary artists, at the Four Seasons riverside ART Space. Runs 16 Oct 2026 - 31 Jan 2027 (dates clipped to the trip window); opening hours and admission are not stated on the page.

events.title: Neilson Hays Library second-hand book sale
events.address: 195 Surawong Rd, Bang Rak, Bangkok
events.notes: Twice-yearly fundraiser sale of pre-loved fiction and non-fiction, mostly in English, with book prices from 20 THB. Sale runs 14-22 Nov 2026, 9:30-17:00, closed 16 Nov; date here is clipped to the trip window start.

events.title: Exhibition: SUDO RUNGU - Echoes of Fire (Roby Dwi Antono)
events.venue: MOCA Bangkok (Museum of Contemporary Art) - Temporary Exhibition 1, 2, 3 and Atrium, G floor
events.address: 499 Kamphaeng Phet 6 Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok
events.price: MOCA admission: adult 400 THB, student with ID 120 THB
events.notes: First solo exhibition in Thailand by Indonesian artist Roby Dwi Antono (paintings, drawings, photographs, video and participatory work), curated by Loredana Pazzini Paracciani. Runs 27 Oct 2026 - 3 Jan 2027 (start clipped to the trip window); MOCA is open Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00 and closed Mondays, and the price shown is the museum's general admission.

events.title: Exhibition: Bas Jan Ader - Bright at Midnight
events.address: 599 Pantachit Alley, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100
events.notes: Three works (1970-1975) by Dutch artist Bas Jan Ader, curated by Leonardo Orion Dal Colle, shown in the Kunsthalle's unfinished architecture. Runs 14 Oct 2026 - 10 Jan 2027 (start clipped to the trip window); free entry, opening hours given as 2pm-8pm with no closed days stated.

events.title: Only Devs Bangkok #130 (formerly ThaiPy): Making AI PRs Reviewable + Local First Harness
events.venue: Event Space at Royal Oak (4th floor)
events.address: 595/10 Soi Sukhumvit 33/1, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110 (BTS Phrom Phong)
events.notes: Monthly developer meetup, edition #130: talks by Linda Lin (Ikigai Digital) on making AI-generated PRs reviewable and Marco Clark (Velociti) on a local-first agent harness. Arrive and mingle 18:30, talks 19:00, lightning talks 20:00, optional socialising after 20:30; snacks and soft drinks provided; RSVP on Meetup. The next listed edition is 21 Jan 2027 (outside the trip window).

events.title: Bangkok | Claude Meetup & Workshop (building practical AI agents)
events.notes: Community evening of lightning talks, production-focused demos, live music and networking on building and deploying AI agents with Claude; mostly English with some Thai, registration and networking from 17:00, food and drinks provided. Capacity is limited, registration requires host approval, and the exact Bangkok address is revealed only to approved attendees.

events.title: Galleries' Nights 2026 - 'New Horizons'
events.notes: Two evenings when 100+ galleries and art spaces across Bangkok stay open late with openings and performances; free, and a very social way to meet the creative scene. Each night typically covers different districts - see the official map.

events.title: Pangaea at AETHER BKK
events.notes: Pangaea at Æther BKK on Friday 20 November 2026 from 21:00. Aggregator-only listing (Techno Airlines, ticket link points to ra.co, which was not reachable); confirm entry/price on the venue's channels.

Early-entry tickets require being inside before 16:00 and standard/VIP before 17:30, with a 400 THB late fee at the gate.

events.price: Members and students (to undergraduate level) free; non-members THB 300
events.organizer: The Siam Society Under Royal Patronage
events.notes: Lecture in the 'Restitution and Repatriation' series by Ruth Whittaker, a British-Cambodian lecturer and legal consultant based in Phnom Penh, on court records as cultural memory. Members and students free, non-members THB 300; enquiries to lectures@thesiamsociety.org.

Aggregator-only listing (Techno Airlines, ticket link points to ra.co, which was not reachable); confirm entry/price on the organiser's channels. No price or lineup was shown.

events.title: Reading in the Park EP5 (5th edition)
events.notes: Phone-free afternoon of reading on the lawn alongside hundreds of others, with small-group chats about literature, art and culture in Thai and English. Entry is free with registration; Time Out suggests arriving around 3pm and bringing a mat, a clip-on light and mosquito spray.

events.address: 1188 Rama IV Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120

Limited to 15 spots, RSVP on Meetup; held Mondays 19:00-21:00, with further sessions listed for 30 Nov and 14 Dec while the Friday sessions are cancelled.

events.title: Loy Krathong 2026 (Bangkok riverside celebrations)
events.venue: Five BMA sites (incl. Khlong Prem Prachakorn near Wat Samian Nari); also riverside spots such as ICONSIAM River Park
events.notes: Loy Krathong 2026 falls on Tue 24 Nov (full moon of the 12th lunar month); a travel guide confirms the date, free citywide celebrations along the Chao Phraya (ICONSIAM, Asiatique) and in public parks, and Culture Ministry activities at Wat Arun and Songwat Rd on 23-24 Nov, with no sky lanterns in Bangkok parks. The BMA five-site programme, organizer and 18:00 opening come from a Nation Thailand article that could not be opened, and the city's 2026 park list had not been announced.

Listed 25-27 Nov, 10:00-18:00, in Halls 7-8 at IMPACT; registration is via the official event site.

Ticket prices were not readable on the page; an aggregator says entry is 20+.
